info.name: File viewers
info.summary: In-browser viewers for notebooks, e-books and comics
info.description: Registers Nextcloud Viewer handlers to display Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb), e-books (.epub) and comic archives (.cbr/.cbz) directly in the browser — including on public shares. Rendering is fully client-side and self-contained (no external services). Pairs with the Importer app so shared notebooks can be viewed and imported, then run as a pod.
info.author: Frederik Orellana, DTU
